description: One edition, as the list at editions.json holds it. An edition is one set of cards.

name.description: The resource name, editions/{edition}. The slug is stable and never reused.

displayName.description: The edition's name as the game shows it, as plain text with no markup.

year.description: The year the edition is for, such as 2026.

updateTime.description: When this edition's content last changed, as an RFC 3339 moment in UTC.
